Suitable for mineral collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, or educational use.

The stone measures 1.25 x 0.85 x 0.75 inches and is freeform, oval to teardrop in shape with a glossy finish. The rich brown matrix displays intricate natural patterns including swirls of tan and cream, along with veins of iridescent blue and green opal play-of-color. The specimen is in nice condition with no visible chips or cracks. Suitable for collectors, lapidary artists, or gemstone enthusiasts.
